title: Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements Terms for Long-Standing Accounts — Summit Gold Tenure Allowance
content:
**Term.** A Gold tenure allowance is taken off the price of a Summit Gold status award redeemed from Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements company points, according to how long the agreement has run, counted in whole calendar months from the agreement's approval date to the redemption date:

- an agreement approved at least 36 whole months before the redemption date takes off 300 points;
- one approved at least 24 whole months but fewer than 36 before it takes off 150 points;
- a younger agreement takes off nothing.

**Where the allowance acts.** The allowance is taken off the Gold award price as it stands once any percentages on it have been applied and the price has been rounded to the whole point; what remains is the net Gold award price.

### Month counts (hypothetical dates)

| Approval date | Redemption date | Whole months | Allowance |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 May, year 1 | 10 May, year 4 | 36 | 300 points |
| 10 May, year 1 | 9 May, year 4 | 35 | 150 points |
| 10 May, year 1 | 10 May, year 3 | 24 | 150 points |
| 10 May, year 1 | 9 May, year 3 | 23 | nothing |

### Example (hypothetical)

A Gold award price of 4180 points on an agreement approved 40 months before the redemption date becomes a net Gold award price of 4180 less 300, that is 3880 points.
